description: This file contains test cases for the openai_batches_endpoint module, specifically testing batch operations such as creating, retrieving, listing, and deleting batches/files, as well as helper functions for batch processing workflows. It uses pytest, asyncio, aiohttp, and openai SDK and mocks certain endpoints.

methods.name: test_batches_operations()
methods.description: Asynchronous pytest test that performs create, retrieve, list, cancel, and delete operations on batches and files, validating their status and responses.

methods.name: str create_batch_oai_sdk(filepath: str, custom_llm_provider: str)
methods.description: Creates a batch for a given file with additional headers and returns its ID after submitting it.

methods.name: await_batch_completion(batch_id: str, custom_llm_provider: str)
methods.description: Polls the status of a batch until it is completed or max tries are reached.

methods.name: str write_content_to_file( batch_id: str, output_path: str, custom_llm_provider: str )
methods.description: Retrieves batch output and content, writing it to a specified output file.

methods.name: read_jsonl(filepath: str)
methods.description: Reads lines from a JSON Lines formatted file, parses, and logs each JSON object.

methods.name: get_any_completed_batch_id_azure()
methods.description: Iterates through batches with Azure provider to find any batch with status 'completed' and returns its ID.

methods.name: test_e2e_batches_files(custom_llm_provider)
methods.description: End-to-end test for batch and file operations with different backend providers, utilizing previously defined helper functions.

methods.name: test_vertex_batches_endpoint()
methods.description: Test for creating a batch with VertexAI provider, currently marked as skipped.

methods.name: test_list_batches_with_target_model_names()
methods.description: Async test mocking behavior for listing batches with target model names, verifying proper filtering and parameter passing.
